newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen steady, wineries shine.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen steady, wineries shine.

text.p: Chilean stocks opened a touch weaker with the market seen holding steady for the rest of the day, although winery shares are expected to resume their rally, said traders.

"It looks as if the wine sector will have a very good year," said Jaime Pena y Lillo, portfolio manager at brokerage Socimer. "(Wineries) Concha y Toro and San Pedro have increased their sales abroad."
Concha y Toro's ADRs opened up 1.09 percent at 34-5/8.
The 40-share .IPSA index slipped 0.09 percent at the opening to 118.58 points.
